# India Weather

> Live weather for India and cities worldwide. Hourly and 7-day forecast, rain, wind, UV, air quality, and plain-language alerts.

## Summary

India Weather is a mobile-first web app built in India for users everywhere. Search any city, use GPS for local weather, save places, and read forecasts in your language.

## Core features

- Hourly and 7-day temperature forecast
- Rainfall, wind, humidity, pressure, visibility
- UV index map and air quality index
- Weather alerts derived from live forecast data (not official IMD bulletins)
- Worldwide city search via Open-Meteo geocoding
- GPS reverse geocoding via BigDataCloud
- 70+ UI languages with device-language default
- Saved places (up to 8, stored on device)

## Data sources

- Forecast: Open-Meteo (https://open-meteo.com)
- Geocoding: Open-Meteo Geocoding API
- Reverse geocode: BigDataCloud Client API
- UI translation: MyMemory (free tier, cached)

## Popular entry points

- Home: /
- Example cities: Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram

## FAQ

Q: What is India Weather?
A: A free weather web app for India and global cities with hourly/7-day forecasts and air quality.

Q: Which languages are supported?
A: English plus 70+ languages. Default follows the user's phone or browser language.

Q: Are alerts official government warnings?
A: No. Alerts are generated from forecast data for planning, not IMD official bulletins.
